meta.name: web-browser
meta.description: Allows to interact with web pages by performing actions such as clicking buttons, filling out forms, and navigating links. It works by remote controlling Google Chrome or Chromium browsers using the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). When Claude needs to browse the web, it can use this skill to do so.

copy.tagline: 远程控制浏览器自动点击、填表、导航
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要让AI帮你操作网页完成重复任务
copy.tagline_en: Remotely control a browser to click, fill forms, and navigate
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI to automate web page interactions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以远程控制 Chrome 浏览器，帮你点击按钮、填写表单、浏览链接、截图、执行 JavaScript 等。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 访问某个网页、获取页面信息或操作网页元素时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开百度首页，搜索“天气”。
say.note: Claude 会导航到百度并执行搜索。
Claude 会返回当前视口的截图。
Claude 会使用元素选择器定位并点击。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can remotely control Chrome to click buttons, fill forms, navigate links, take screenshots, and execute JavaScript on web pages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to visit a webpage, retrieve page information, or interact with page elements.

say_en.text: Open Baidu homepage and search for 'weather'.
say_en.note: Claude will navigate to Baidu and perform the search.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the current page.
say_en.note: Claude will return a screenshot of the current viewport.

say_en.text: Click the 'Login' button on the page.
say_en.note: Claude will use the element picker to locate and click.
